denominator_definition: all source metadata rows for flow and prevalence; all successfully scored nonconflicting source rows for statement metrics
restricted_definition: retain scored rows with at least one of this profile's defensibly mapped statements; this is a new SPH restriction, not a replay of historical panel selection
routing: no abstention, cascade or clinical referral executed; P8 can apply its original top-1 fallback
reference_semantics: for a defensibly mapped statement, absence means not documented in SPH and is never absence of disease; Normal ECG with any other primary statement is ambiguous and excluded from metrics only
